title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Simulating Context-Aware Disease Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2512.08029v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical decision-making in oncology requires forecasting how disease evolves under treatment, yet most AI systems remain static predictors that cannot model longitudinal, treatment-conditioned progression. Although generative and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in general domains, their adaptation to medicine remains limited and insufficient for capturing complex, treatment-induced physiological dynamics across temporal scales. To address these gaps, we introduce CLARITY, a medical world model that enables counterfactual simulation of treatment-conditioned disease trajectories for clinical decision-making. By jointly encoding imaging-derived latent states, temporal intervals that capture irregular follow-ups, and patient-specific clinical context, CLARITY learns smooth and interpretable representations of disease progression, allowing the model to simulate how alternative treatments reshape future disease dynamics

translated_title: CLARITY：通过模拟情境感知的疾病轨迹来指导治疗决策的医学世界模型
translated_abstract: 肿瘤学中的临床决策需要预测疾病在治疗下的演变过程，然而大多数AI系统仍然是静态预测器，无法对纵向的、以治疗为条件的疾病进展进行建模。尽管生成式模型和世界模型在通用领域已展现出强大的能力，但它们在医学领域的适配仍然有限，不足以捕捉跨时间尺度上复杂的、由治疗引起的生理动态变化。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了CLARITY，这是一个医学世界模型，能够对以治疗为条件的疾病轨迹进行反事实模拟，以辅助临床决策。通过联合编码源自影像的潜在状态、捕捉不规则随访的时间间隔以及患者特定的临床背景信息，CLARITY学习到疾病进展的平滑且可解释的表示，使模型能够模拟不同治疗方案如何重塑未来的疾病动态。
tldr: CLARITY是一个医学世界模型，通过联合编码影像潜在状态、不规则随访时间间隔和患者临床背景，实现对不同治疗方案下疾病轨迹的反事实模拟，从而指导肿瘤学的临床治疗决策。
en_tdlr: CLARITY is a medical world model that jointly encodes imaging-derived latent states, irregular follow-up intervals, and patient-specific clinical context to enable counterfactual simulation of treatment-conditioned disease trajectories, guiding oncology treatment decisions.
